QuestInfo.name: [Spring Valley] Chase Them Away - Butterflies
QuestInfo.0: Navy Tail has a top secret calling to 'aid' the insects of Spring Valley. \r\nJoin her, and chase the insects of Spring Valley out of their homes and away from the greedy eyes of potential insect collectors.
QuestInfo.1: The butterflies of Spring Valley are colorful and beautiful. Navy Tail fears they'll be thoughtlessly captured by insect collectors, so she's thoughtfully decided to chase them far, far away.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Navy Tail chase the insects far, far away. Now they can live in strange, harsh lands far from their homes and away from the grasp of potential insect collectors!

0.0: Oh, dearie me. The butterflies in the valley are simply lovely. So very lovely. Entirely TOO lovely.
0.1: How could an insect collector resist them, you know? They'll net and slaughter and stuff and mount them like they're some sort of trophy, and Spring Valley will have no butterflies left!
0.3: I've thought it over very carefully and decided we MUST get involved.\r\n#b#eWe'll chase those butterflies far, far away, out of harm's way, even if it means we have to attack them to do it! Will you help me?

yes.0: We have no choice. We must act before it's too late!
yes.1: Attack 100 of the butterflies flying lazily about, until they flee in absolute terror. That's the only way to help them.

no.0: Take some time to think it through. You'll agree with me in the end.

1.0: Oh, you did a wonderful job!

yes.0: This idyllic spot will feel so lonely without those butterflies, but better they live their lives elsewhere than end up on some grubby collector's wall.

mob.0: I still see entirely too many butterflies. Please, you must chase more of them away! They're counting on us!
